title: Sum 1 to N
statement:
Write a function that takes a positive integer n and returns the sum of every integer from 1 to n inclusive.
Example: sum_to_n(4) → 10 because 1+2+3+4 = 10.
hints: Loop i from 1 to n and add i to total each time.
Return total after the loop ends.

solution.approach: Initialize total = 0. For i from 1 to n, add i. Return total. (You can also use the formula n*(n+1)/2 later.)
solution.complexity: About n additions — grows gently with n.

analogy: washing plates one by one until you finish the stack
